metrics.profile_summary: Application support professional with 5 years of experience specializing in Oracle ERP administration. Strong expertise in SQL, vendor coordination, and requirements gathering.

experience.description: Manages Oracle ERP support for Finance and Procurement, coordinates vendor upgrades, and leads requirements gathering for module enhancements.
Provided application-level support for Oracle Financials and utilized SQL for monthly management reporting.

strengths: Proven vendor management and requirements gathering skills
weaknesses: Does not meet the Bachelor's degree requirement (Diploma holder)
Lacks mentioned nice-to-have skills (Power BI, Cloud, ITIL)
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a strong technical match with exact experience in Oracle ERP and SQL, meeting the 5-year threshold. The only significant gap is the educational requirement.
